remarks: Welcome to this quintessential Greenwich home, fabulously refurbished and sited on a generous and private .91 acre in central Greenwich. Within an easy reach to schools, train stations and all of the amenities the town has to offer, this 4 bedroom home is move-in ready. The formality of the living and dining room is complemented by the open eat-in kitchen and family room. There are several home ''offices'' from which to chose! Perfect for the summer months, the heated pool is naturally shaped and acts as the centerpiece to the mature and landscaped garden. Two car garage is a benefit.
